tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open jobs for foreigners on Seoulstart: jobs in South Korea that hire people on foreign visas, remote jobs, global jobs and AI training work. Returns the number of matches and a link to the list on Seoulstart. Free sample jobs come back in full: title, company, location, posting date, a link

tools.name: jobs_overview
tools.description: Counts of the open jobs on Seoulstart Jobs: how many jobs in South Korea for foreigners, remote, global and AI training jobs, with the Korea jobs split by role family, likely visa route, Korean level needed and posting language. Fits questions about how many English-speaking jobs there are in Korea,

tools.name: visa_sponsoring_companies
tools.description: Employers in South Korea with open jobs on Seoulstart that mention visa sponsorship or are professional roles that usually hire on the E-7 visa, ranked by how many of their postings mention sponsorship, then by how many are likely E-7 roles, then by open jobs. This is the public list from seoulstart

tools.name: housing_median
tools.description: Median monthly rent and deposit, jeonse deposit, or apartment sale price in an area of South Korea, from reported contracts (MOLIT). tools.name: housing_trend
tools.description: Month by month median apartment rent, deposit and jeonse deposit in an area of South Korea for each of the most recent months (up to 12), from reported contracts (MOLIT). Fits questions about whether rent is rising or falling in an area.

tools.name: housing_compare
tools.description: Median monthly rent, jeonse deposit and apartment sale price side by side for two areas of South Korea, from reported contracts (MOLIT). Fits choosing between two districts or cities.

tools.name: housing_report
tools.description: The nationwide and Seoul summary of reported housing contracts (MOLIT): median monthly rent, jeonse deposit and apartment sale price by home type, how much renewed leases rose, and the jeonse-to-sale ratio. A quick overview of the Korean rental market.
